(5) Anime 5E /api/systems/anime-5e/reference returns abilities=[STR,DEX,CON,INT,WIS,CHA], rule_note starts with 'Anime 5E is D&D 5E + an OPTIONAL BESM-style point-buy LAYER', class count=17, and Adept/Champion/Idol/Pilot/Tinker primaries are 5E ability names (Wisdom/Strength/Charisma/Intelligence/Intelligence) — no BOD/MND/SOL leaks. 

OLD iter31_v60 regression: 8/9 still pass; the 1 failure is the SAME pre-existing motive-drop bug captured in iter33 (Lyra/Luminar motives silently dropped because seed motive npc_name uses a TRUNCATED form that doesn't match the node title). 

FRONTEND ISSUE: Anime5eHybridSupplement.jsx has THREE remaining 'Tri-Stat' leftover strings that V6.1 did not scrub: line 91 dropdown placeholder '+ Add Tri-Stat Attribute…', line 102 empty-state 'Pick a Tri-Stat Attribute above to add a point-buy power.', and line 136 footer 'Tri-Stat point-buy adds genre-flavoured powers.' The header was correctly updated to 'BESM Point-Buy Layer' (line 61) but the inner copy still references Tri-Stat. The review_request explicitly required: 'empty-state line says "Pick a BESM-style attribute above"' and 'footer disclaimer mentions one-way compatible' — both missing.

minor.issue: Lyra Earthheart and Luminar motive entries (and Senator Vox Populi) are silently DROPPED at demo_seed.py:488 because the motive tuple uses a TRUNCATED npc_name ('Lyra Earthheart — EarthMancer' / 'Luminar — Deacon of Light') that does NOT match the node title ('Lyra Earthheart — Deaconess of the Elements / EarthMancer' / 'Luminar — Deacon of Light / Light Weaver'). name_to_node_id.get(npc_name) returns None and 'if not nid: continue' skips the insert. RESULT: only 6 motives created in DB instead of canonical 9. /ecosystem/pulse?plot_phase=epic-9-adventures returns 3 active_motives (Vaelin/Morrigan/The Kin) instead of the expected 5 (+ Lyra + Luminar). Fix: either align the motive tuple's npc_name with the canonical node title, or change the lookup to be substring/prefix-tolerant.

Empty-state copy still reads 'Pick a Tri-Stat Attribute above to add a point-buy power.' Review_request mandates 'Pick a BESM-style attribute above'.

Footer disclaimer still reads 'Tri-Stat point-buy adds genre-flavoured powers.' — review_request mandates 'one-way compatible' disclaimer language. Also no 'one-way port' visible in rendered DOM (only in JSDoc comment).

Per review_request: placeholder→'+ Add BESM-style Attribute…', empty-state→'Pick a BESM-style attribute above to add a point-buy power.', footer→include 'one-way compatible' phrasing.

Backend: fix motive-drop bug in /app/backend/routes/demo_seed.py:486-498. Either rename motive tuple keys ('Lyra Earthheart — EarthMancer' → 'Lyra Earthheart — Deaconess of the Elements / EarthMancer'; 'Luminar — Deacon of Light' → 'Luminar — Deacon of Light / Light Weaver') so name_to_node_id matches, OR change the lookup logic to do prefix/substring matching. (Optional) Senator Vox Populi motive is also dropped — node title 'Senator Vox Populi' does exist (verified) but motive uses 'Senator Vox Populi' identically; if it's still missing, audit whether the genesis-3-nemesis phase filter eats it.

Recommend either ASSERTing or LOGGING when a motive's npc_name fails lookup, so this kind of regression is caught at seed time. Today it costs us 33% of the canonical motive set without any warning.

rca of the issue:
TWO independent bugs surfaced in V6.1: 
(A) Frontend partial-rewrite — Anime5eHybridSupplement.jsx had its <h3> header updated from 'Tri-Stat Supplement' → 'BESM Point-Buy Layer', but the inline JSX strings inside the dropdown <option>, the empty-state <div>, and the footer <div> were missed. Confirmed by reading the file directly: line 91, 102, 136 all still say 'Tri-Stat'. The JSDoc block at the top mentions 'one-way port' but that is in a comment, NOT rendered. 
(B) Backend pre-existing motive truncation — demo_seed.py EVEREANTHA blob defines 9 motives keyed by NPC name, but for Lyra and Luminar the motive npc_name was shortened (probably for readability) to 'Lyra Earthheart — EarthMancer' and 'Luminar — Deacon of Light' while the corresponding node TITLES include extra suffix '/ Deaconess of the Elements / EarthMancer' and '/ Light Weaver'. The demo_seed.py:487 lookup `name_to_node_id.get(npc_name)` therefore returns None and the next line silently `continue`s. Reproduction: POST /api/admin/seed-evereantha-suite as GMFran, then count `db.node_motives.find({campaign_id: <besm_cid>})` — returns 6, expected 9. Mitigation A: align the motive npc_name string EXACTLY with the node title. Mitigation B: change demo_seed.py to do `name_to_node_id.get(npc_name) or next((nid for t,nid in name_to_node_id.items() if t.startswith(npc_name)), None)` — substring/prefix-tolerant. Either fix is one-line.
